Under the protection of the garrisoned military, this area is relatively heavily populated, with small villages dotting the central, southern, and southeastern parts, as well as a large cliff-side settlement along the waterfall and river to the east. {{TOCleft}} ==Getting there== Exiting via the east exit of the [[Command Post]] will bring characters here, most likely while following the [[Acolyte of Balthazar]] and [[Corporal Argon]] are in groups there, with the [[Treasure Chest]] between them on one side. ==Notes== {{gw2w}} *Despite having hidden [[Mandragor]]s spread out in the open areas of this location, [[Mandragor Hunt]] is not available here. *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.3% to the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title track. *{{Vanquisher|count = 281|low = 251|high = 310}} **Be aware that the fortress ramps to the northeast contains several large groups of elite [[Kournan military]]. Careful [[pull]]ing is critical. Anti-melee skills and [[physical damage]] mitigation is helpful. *A huge mountain can be seen when looking west-northwest, it is clear when entering from [[Kodonur Crossroads (outpost)|Kodonur Crossroads]].
